## Highlights

- Codex agents can select GPT-6.1 Sol through an OpenAI subscription credential. The model
  catalog now records its Responses API requirement, so incompatible native chat and agent
  runtimes refuse it before sending a tool request.
  [Provider setup](https://docs.tale.dev/platform/admin/providers)
- Subscription broker cooldowns immediately following the same agent's rate-limit failure
  no longer consume an extra automated-start allowance. Manager agents can read whether a
  failed task run still has a pending automatic retry.
  [#4143](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4143)
- Self-hosted setup gains read-only `tale doctor` diagnostics, more reliable startup and
  local host/port handling, and `tale dev --stop` to stop development containers while
  preserving their data. Unix and Windows installation guidance includes recovery steps.
  [#4142](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4142)
- Home names a failed chat or task read and offers a retry instead of presenting an empty
  result. [#4136](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4136)
- Cleanup retains file bytes while another live reference still needs them.
  [#4129](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4129)
- Project owners can see why the agent review setting is unavailable and which organization
  grant enables it. [#4132](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4132)
- GitHub and package discovery now point readers to the published guides, and full releases
  require authored highlights and upgrade notes before publication.
  [#4134](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4134)

## Upgrade notes

- The changes from v0.5.70 add no database migration or required environment variable. Follow
  the [self-hosted upgrade guide](https://docs.tale.dev/self-hosted/operate/upgrades) to install
  the updated model catalog.
- To use GPT-6.1 Sol with a subscription, configure an OpenAI subscription credential and
  choose Codex for the agent. The subscription must include access to this model. Direct chat
  uses Chat Completions and does not support this model's tool calls.
- Native task tools use contract 3.15.0. Managers must preserve an armed automatic retry
  when `task_get.agentRuns[].retryPending` is `true`; `false` does not authorize a restart,
  and a missing field on an older deployment means unknown. Reconcile current task state
  and respect provider waits before starting work.
- Release operators must merge the intended version's authored notes before selecting its
  candidate. See [the release runbook](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/blob/main/.github/RELEASING.md).
